body.name: Chen--Oberst monotonicity-only envelopes
body.construction:
For \(S\in\mathcal P_k\), a compatible selected mean table \(y\), and \(t\in[0,1]\), define, when \(a\neq a_0\),
\[
\ell^{\mathrm{CO}}_{xa}(t;y)
=\max\bigl(\{0\}\cup\{y_{cx}:c\in T_{xa}(S),\ m_c\leq t\}\bigr),
\qquad
u^{\mathrm{CO}}_{xa}(t;y)
=\min\bigl(\{1\}\cup\{y_{cx}:c\in T_{xa}(S),\ m_c\geq t\}\bigr).
\]
For \(a=a_0\), define
\[
\ell^{\mathrm{CO}}_{x a_0}(t;y)
=\max\bigl(\{0\}\cup\{y_{cx}:c\in T_{x a_0}(S)\}\bigr),
\qquad
u^{\mathrm{CO}}_{x a_0}(t;y)
=\min\bigl(\{1\}\cup\{y_{cx}:c\in T_{x a_0}(S)\}\bigr).
\]
